audience: AI and machine learning teams that run GPU Pods and Serverless endpoints on Runpod

useCases.title: Check which Pods run and what they cost
useCases.text: List the Pods and open one to see its GPU, container and status. Read the billing of each Pod by time bucket.

useCases.title: Review spend and balance
useCases.text: Read the account balance and the billing mode. Read the billing history of Pods, Serverless and storage in time buckets.

useCases.title: Check GPU stock before a deploy
useCases.text: Read the account limits. List the GPU types with their prices and availability, and the data centers in a region.

useCases.title: Check a Serverless endpoint under load
useCases.text: Open one Serverless endpoint and list its active workers. Read its request counts and queue delay over time.

useCases.title: Start or stop a Pod
useCases.text: Start a stopped Pod, or stop a running one. A stopped Pod does not bill compute, but its volume disk still bills.

useCases.title: Terminate a Pod permanently
useCases.text: Terminate a Pod to release its compute. This cannot be undone: host-local storage is destroyed. A network volume is only detached.
